blocks: The saved-parameter inspector preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix assignments follow the Freakout live map. Mode, LFO shape, filter type and octave labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.

Read from the connected MicroFreak's slot 207 over USB on October 25, 2026 with mise run microfreak:download --slot 207. The file is the preset header followed by the unmodified data packets the device sends, as described in the download task. It is not a MIDI Control Center .mbp file.
